description: MobiData BW is the open data platform for mobility data in the German state of Baden-Württemberg. On behalf of the state Ministry of Transport it bundles mobility data and publishes them under open licences; its CKAN catalogue lists 146 datasets from 27 organisations in ten categories, including public transport (24 datasets), parking (15), traffic counts (14), walking and cycling (11), sharing services (8), transport networks (6), accessibility, e-mobility and traffic events. Examples are planned timetable data for the whole state, bike sharing feeds and car park occupancy. It is run by the team for mobility data and innovation of the Nahverkehrsgesellschaft Baden-Württemberg (NVBW), whose own open data page offers statewide stop, timetable and infrastructure data for regional rail and public transport. Coverage is regional. Data are free to download and many are available through APIs, in formats such as CSV, GeoJSON, shapefiles, GTFS, GBFS, GraphQL and WMS/WFS; most datasets use CC BY 4.0 or the Datenlizenz Deutschland attribution 2.0, with some under CC0, ODbL or other terms. Caveats: licences differ between datasets, and the departure monitor service is being replaced by the end of 2027. The platform supports public transport network models, accessibility and multimodal flow studies, and parking and charging capacity planning. It complements the German public transport accessibility maps and the GTFS and GBFS specifications catalogued here.
